request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone, broad dark slate ceramic roof elements where appropriate, aged copper structural accents, elegant stepped foundations and restrained luminous details. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. Research Laboratory: two asymmetrical pale limestone study pavilions joined by a broad low corridor around a thick closed faceted copper assay chamber. One pavilion longer and lower; the other a compact square mass. Dark slate roofs on the pavilions, one low copper polygonal chamber crown, NOT a dome, tower, telescope or chimney. Broad shallow inset amber observation panels on the chamber, restrained tiny turquoise connection inset. Read as an exploratory experimental institution rather than a factory or greenhouse. Keep a strong asymmetric silhouette, no repeated U courtyard, no gears, pipes, chemistry signs, antennas, thin glass structures or modern laboratory equipment. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs closed except the explicitly intended architectural passage or open plaza. Windows only simple shallow framed recessed panels, never perforations. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.

request.text_style_prompt: Original knowledge-city research laboratory. Two unequal pavilions with warm pale limestone block walls, recessed stone panels and stepped limestone plinths; dark slate ceramic hipped roofs with aged copper edges and copper corner pilasters. A central faceted test chamber clad in aged copper with restrained verdigris, broad warm amber glass panels and a few tiny contained turquoise insets. Copper stays on the chamber and trims; walls stay limestone. Broad calm hand-crafted stylized material regions readable from an elevated strategy-game camera, subtle stone variation, restrained weathering. Preserve the geometry. No text, logos, grime, baked lighting or baked shadows. Limestone matte, slate moderately rough, copper metallic.
